title: Five-minute visual pilot — The Register / The City That Counted Us
source_policy: Adapt only the Prologue and Chapter 1 source passages. Visual metaphors are marked as adaptation choices. Verify exact manuscript passages and dialogue before lock.
style: Grounded realistic 3D character and environment modelling; physically based skin, hair, fabric, glass, metal, concrete and painted surfaces; cinematic 720p lighting and depth of field; expressive but restrained acting; carefully motivated camera movement. All unsourced appearance details remain provisional pending author approval.

shots.title: The first list
shots.visual_action: Slow aerial drift into a monumental civic registry hall; a long queue is organised by floor markings and counters. The camera descends toward a clerk's hands aligning paper records.
shots.camera_plan: Wide to macro insert; slow push; no spectacle. Establish geometry and institutional scale.
shots.performance_or_action: A clerk squares a stack of census sheets; pauses over a category column. No invented dialogue.
shots.sound_plan: Low room tone, paper movement, distant ventilation
shots.continuity_and_review_notes: Opening image must feel ordinary before it feels threatening.

shots.title: Only numbers
shots.visual_action: Macro details: a finger follows a column; a stamp lands; a file slides into a tray. The clerk's hand hesitates before the next record.
shots.camera_plan: Macro inserts with graphic match cuts; controlled shallow focus.
shots.performance_or_action: The clerk's hand stops for a beat, then continues. The question is carried by narration, not invented dialogue.
shots.sound_plan: Stamp transients become a measured pulse; no music cue locked yet
shots.continuity_and_review_notes: The system is built from mundane actions.

shots.title: The category becomes a gate
shots.visual_action: A corridor of service doors; a family waits as one door opens for another group. Keep faces and outcomes restrained; show access as spatial choreography.
shots.camera_plan: Symmetrical wide; lateral track; doorframe wipes.
shots.performance_or_action: No new plot event: visualise the source's account of categories shaping access to services.
shots.sound_plan: Air tone and distant footsteps; restrained low-frequency texture
shots.continuity_and_review_notes: Avoid depicting an unmentioned specific family or invented denial incident as canon; use anonymous background staging.

shots.title: A door that opens one way
shots.visual_action: Close on a one-way turnstile and a category-marked card. The card is accepted on one side; the camera holds on the locked reverse side.
shots.camera_plan: Low-angle close-up; rack focus from card to barrier; deliberate hold.
shots.performance_or_action: Metaphorical insert only; label design and exact interface remain provisional.
shots.sound_plan: A soft mechanical click; music remains undecided
shots.continuity_and_review_notes: Graphic metaphor must not imply a new plot mechanism.

shots.title: Vesper at street level
shots.visual_action: Hard cut to Vesper in 2044: layered street depth, public screens, transit, checkpoints in the distance. Kaylen moves through the city as one person inside a vast system.
shots.camera_plan: Wide moving master; foreground parallax; purposeful tracking.
shots.performance_or_action: Kaylen navigates his ordinary route. Keep the city grounded and inhabited, not a generic cyberpunk skyline.
shots.sound_plan: City bed, distant traffic, soft broadcast bleed
shots.continuity_and_review_notes: Architecture and political signage require source bible continuity check.

shots.title: The morning after
shots.visual_action: Kaylen sits with cold coffee while a broadcast speaks in polished phrases about community resilience. Camera observes the gap between public language and his private fatigue.
shots.camera_plan: Medium profile; restrained push-in; cutaway to cold cup and TV glow.
shots.performance_or_action: Kaylen drinks cold coffee; broadcast omits names pending official release. Do not add broadcaster dialogue beyond the source's described content.
shots.sound_plan: Muffled broadcast texture; cup set-down; restrained room tone
shots.continuity_and_review_notes: Interior location and exact broadcast copy need source-page verification.

shots.title: Glass has a clean voice
shots.visual_action: A memory fragment: a bottle breaks on pavement. Show the shard scatter and Kaylen's stillness, not a choreographed fight or glamorised violence.
shots.camera_plan: Close handheld drift; one sharp insert; sound-led cut.
shots.performance_or_action: Use the source memory of the broken bottle as sensory recollection. Do not depict extra blows or weapon use.
shots.sound_plan: Single glass break with brief subjective muffling; no music stinger
shots.continuity_and_review_notes: Non-graphic, subjective memory; avoid adding action detail.

shots.title: Come through
shots.visual_action: Phone vibrates. The message from Eamon appears; Kaylen deletes it, then retrieves it from the deleted folder. The smallest decision becomes a visible struggle.
shots.camera_plan: Over-shoulder phone insert; locked frame; rack to Kaylen's eyes.
shots.performance_or_action: Use only the source message wording if the author approves exact on-screen text; otherwise show sender and abstracted message.
shots.sound_plan: Phone vibration, thumb contact, room tone
shots.continuity_and_review_notes: Phone interface is a designed asset and must be approved.

shots.title: The print shop
shots.visual_action: Exterior-to-interior transition into the disused print shop; black-painted windows; the crew's hand-drawn name and music note on the wall.
shots.camera_plan: Tracking move through doorway; reveal group tableau with layered depth.
shots.performance_or_action: Introduce the gathering place exactly as described. No new gang insignia beyond the source's marker drawing.
shots.sound_plan: Street bed falls away into room tone, kettle and distant voices
shots.continuity_and_review_notes: Crew mark lettering and set dressing require design review.

shots.title: Ordinary lives
shots.visual_action: A series of connected holds: Kesh asleep with phone; Amel at two screens; Rasha mending a sleeve; Sefu working on a kettle; Tovin's school application.
shots.camera_plan: Short lateral dolly with motivated inserts; each insert held long enough to read.
shots.performance_or_action: Show the specific activities from the manuscript. Avoid inventing extra props or character backstory.
shots.sound_plan: Kettle metal ticks, paper, soft room chatter
shots.continuity_and_review_notes: Five distinct performances; no repeated generic idle loops.

shots.title: Care without demand
shots.visual_action: Juno approaches Kaylen with a medical pouch and cleans his split lip. He looks down; she does not force eye contact.
shots.camera_plan: Intimate two-shot; hand insert; slow push; no melodramatic close-up.
shots.performance_or_action: Use the source interaction and its quiet care. Preserve the understated tone.
shots.sound_plan: Soft cloth movement, cap click, low room tone
shots.continuity_and_review_notes: Injury continuity: split lip visible from prior scene.

shots.title: The room changes
shots.visual_action: Biko and Amel exchange their clock joke; the door opens and Eamon enters in a dark coat. Lark's voice from the back punctures the claim that everyone is present. End on Kaylen's reaction.
shots.camera_plan: Group master to doorway reveal; slow dolly; final close-up held to cut black.
shots.performance_or_action: Use only dialogue verified in the manuscript. The final beat is Lark's correction, not an invented confrontation.
shots.sound_plan: Door hinge, room chatter drops, final breath then cut
shots.continuity_and_review_notes: End on unresolved tension; do not reveal the stranger or later plot early.

Timing and continuity check at 24 fps
